nftables now the default backend

2026-09-14

The iptables package now defaults to the nft backend, which is the same change every other distribution made over the last two years. The command names are unchanged and the rules you already have keep working; what has moved is what runs underneath them.

If you have rules written against the legacy backend, install iptables-nft-compat before the next reboot, or the firewall will come up empty. Everybody else needs to do nothing at all.
